cues.zh: 总是有各种各样的压力，

cues.en: Sometimes it feels like it's right up on me,
cues.zh: 有时候感觉它就压在我头上，

cues.en: I can just feel it, like literally feel it in my head. And it's relentless and
cues.zh: 我能感觉得到，字面意义上脑子里能感觉到。而且它没完没了，

cues.en: I don't know if it's gonna stop. I mean that's the thing that scares me the most is that I don't know if it's ever gonna stop.
cues.zh: 我不知道它会不会停下来。我的意思是，最让我害怕的就是我不知道它到底会不会停下来。

cues.en: It is not about the nail. Are you sure? Because, I mean, I'll bet if we got that out of there... Stop trying to fix it. No. I'm not trying to fix it. I'm just pointing out that maybe the nail is causing... You always do this. You always try to fix things when what I really need is for you to just listen. See, I don't think that is what you need. I think what you need is to get the nail See, you're not even listening now. Okay. Fine. I will listen. Fine.
cues.zh: 这根本不是钉子的事。你确定吗？因为，我是说，我敢打赌要是把它拔出来……别总想着解决问题。不。我不是想解决问题。我只是指出也许这颗钉子导致了……你总是这样。你总想解决问题，而我真正需要的是你只要听我说。你看，我觉得你需要的不是这个。我觉得你需要的是把钉子……你看，你现在根本没在听。好吧。行。我听着。行吧。

cues.en: I don't know what it is.
And I'm not sleeping very well at all. And all my sweaters sweaters are snagged, I mean all of them.
cues.zh: 而且我觉也睡不好。我所有的毛衣都抽丝了，我是说每一件都这样。

cues.en: Ow. Oh, come on. If you would just... Don't.
cues.zh: 噢。得了吧。要是你肯……别这样。
